note: Shared Word web topics for every level. Each topic lists words from any level; a level shows only its own words (topics with fewer than 3 are hidden unless they are a word's only home). sentences: level -> a sentence using only that level's and earlier words; a level without its own sentence uses the nearest lower one. Order and groups here are the order and groups on screen.

1.zh: 你好！谢谢你，再见！
1.en: Hello! Thank you, goodbye!

2.zh: 不好意思，请问洗手间在哪儿？
2.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

1.zh: 他是我的朋友，她是我的同学，我们都很好。
1.en: He is my friend, she is my classmate, and we are all well.

2.zh: 我自己做饭，大家都说好吃。
2.en: I cook for myself, and everyone says it is tasty.

3.zh: 咱们一起去吧，别的同学已经走了。
3.en: Let us go together; the other students have already left.

1.zh: 这个很好，那个太贵了。
1.en: This one is good; that one is too expensive.

2.zh: 今天这里人这么多！
2.en: There are so many people here today!

1.zh: 你叫什么名字？你住在哪儿？
1.en: What is your name? Where do you live?

2.zh: 你今天为什么不去学校？
2.en: Why aren't you going to school today?

1.zh: 我家有三口人，他八岁，她十岁。
1.en: There are three people in my family; he is eight and she is ten.

2.zh: 这个手机一万块，太贵了。
2.en: This phone costs ten thousand yuan; that is too expensive.

1.zh: 你有多少钱？我有一点儿。
1.en: How much money do you have? I have a little.

2.zh: 每个人都有一些书。
2.en: Everyone has some books.

3.zh: 这里来了好多人，一共有一百个，几乎都是学生。
3.en: Lots of people have come here, a hundred in all, and almost all of them are students.

1.zh: 我买了三本书、两件衣服和一个苹果。
1.en: I bought three books, two items of clothing and an apple.

2.zh: 这位老师有两条狗和一只猫。
2.en: This teacher has two dogs and a cat.

3.zh: 我买了一双新鞋，也给朋友写了一封信。
3.en: I bought a pair of new shoes and also wrote a letter to a friend.

3.zh: 一个苹果三毛，我买了两个。
3.en: One apple costs three mao, and I bought two.

1.zh: 我叫小明，认识你很高兴。
1.en: My name is Xiaoming; nice to meet you.

2.zh: 我来介绍一下，这是我的朋友，他叫小明。
2.en: Let me introduce my friend; his name is Xiaoming.

1.zh: 这个人是我的朋友，那个小朋友是他的孩子。
1.en: This person is my friend, and that child is his child.

2.zh: 这个男孩儿是我的同学，那个女孩儿是我的朋友。
2.en: This boy is my classmate and that girl is my friend.

3.zh: 阿姨和叔叔是我爸爸妈妈的朋友。
3.en: Auntie and Uncle are friends of my mum and dad.

3.zh: 我的邻居很热情，常常请同事来家里玩。
3.en: My neighbour is very friendly and often invites colleagues to visit.

1.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、姐姐和我。
1.en: There are five people in my family: dad, mom, older brother, older sister and me.

2.zh: 我爷爷奶奶住在我家，他们身体很好。
2.en: My grandparents live in our home; they are in good health.

3.zh: 他们是夫妻，她的姐妹也住在这个城市。
3.en: They are husband and wife, and her sisters also live in this city.

1.zh: 我女儿八岁，她是小学生。
1.en: My daughter is eight; she is a primary-school student.

2.zh: 我小时候住在中国，从小就喜欢吃饺子。
2.en: I lived in China when I was little, and I have liked dumplings since I was a child.

3.zh: 他很年轻，二十五岁就结婚了，还养了一只狗。
3.en: He is young: he got married at twenty-five and also keeps a dog.

1.zh: 我在公司工作，今天很忙。
1.en: I work at a company, and I am busy today.

2.zh: 我哥哥是医生，今天他上班很忙。
2.en: My older brother is a doctor, and he is busy at work today.

3.zh: 经理在办公室开会，司机在外面等他。
3.en: The manager is having a meeting in the office, and the driver is waiting for him outside.

1.zh: 今天是四月五日，明天是星期天。
1.en: Today is April 5th, and tomorrow is Sunday.

2.zh: 下个星期五是我的生日。
2.en: Next Friday is my birthday.

3.zh: 工作日我很忙，周末才有时间。
3.en: On weekdays I am busy, and only at the weekend do I have time.

3.zh: 一年有四季：春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。
3.en: A year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

3.zh: 学校放假了，我们回家过节。
3.en: School has closed for the holiday, so we are going home to celebrate the festival.

1.zh: 现在几点？现在是七点半。
1.en: What time is it? It is half past seven.

2.zh: 请等一会儿，现在是下午三点十分。
2.en: Please wait a moment; it is ten past three in the afternoon.

3.zh: 火车晚点了，我们等了半天，所以迟到了。
3.en: The train was late, we waited for ages, and so we were late ourselves.

1.zh: 你在做什么？我正在看电视。
1.en: What are you doing? I am watching TV.

2.zh: 我已经吃饭了，你经常在这里吃饭吗？
2.en: I have already eaten; do you often eat here?

3.zh: 我平时六点起床，今天八点才起床。
3.en: I usually get up at six, but today I only got up at eight.

3.zh: 我刚到家，雨突然下大了。
3.en: I had just got home when it suddenly started to rain hard.

topics.name: Food and meals
topics.cta: Use these when you order food or drinks

1.zh: 我早饭吃面包，午饭吃米饭，晚饭吃饺子。
1.en: I eat bread for breakfast, rice for lunch and dumplings for dinner.

2.zh: 这家饭馆的鱼很好吃，我们去吃吧。
2.en: The fish at this restaurant is very tasty; let us go and eat.

3.zh: 我饿了，请给我菜单，我想尝一尝这个菜。
3.en: I am hungry now. Please give me the menu, because I want to try this dish.

3.zh: 夏天我喜欢吃西瓜和冰激凌，很甜也很凉快。
3.en: In summer I like eating watermelon and ice cream; they are sweet and cool.

1.zh: 苹果是我最喜欢的水果。
1.en: Apples are my favourite fruit.

topics.name: Drinks
topics.cta: Use these when you order food or drinks

1.zh: 我喝茶，他喝牛奶，你喝水吗？
1.en: I drink tea, he drinks milk; do you drink water?

2.zh: 我喝咖啡，她喝奶茶，他们喝红茶。
2.en: I drink coffee, she drinks milk tea and they drink black tea.

3.zh: 我很渴，想喝一杯冰的饮料。
3.en: I am very thirsty and want a cold drink with ice.

3.zh: 请给我一个碗和一双筷子。
3.en: Please give me a bowl and a pair of chopsticks.

1.zh: 请给我一个杯子。
1.en: Please give me a cup.

topics.name: Money and shopping
topics.cta: Use these when you ask a price

1.zh: 这件衣服多少钱？太贵了，我想买便宜的。
1.en: How much is this piece of clothing? It is too expensive; I want to buy a cheaper one.

2.zh: 商场里的东西很贵，超市的便宜一点儿。
2.en: Things in the mall are expensive; the supermarket's are a little cheaper.

3.zh: 我没有带银行卡，可以用信用卡吗？
3.en: I did not bring my bank card. Can I use a credit card?

1.zh: 这件衣服很好看，你想穿吗？
1.en: This piece of clothing is pretty; do you want to wear it?

2.zh: 这条裤子和这个包都很好看。
2.en: These trousers and this bag are both pretty.

3.zh: 天气热，我穿衬衫和短裤。
3.en: It is hot, so I am wearing a shirt and shorts.

topics.name: Places around town
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我去商店买东西，也去书店看书。
1.en: I go to the shop to buy things, and I also go to the bookstore to read.

2.zh: 机场离酒店很远，我们坐地铁去。
2.en: The airport is far from the hotel; we go by subway.

3.zh: 图书馆在公园旁边，银行在体育馆后面。
3.en: The library is next to the park, and the bank is behind the gym.

3.zh: 这个城市很大，我家小区附近的环境很好。
3.en: This city is very big, and the surroundings near my neighbourhood are very nice.

topics.name: Directions and positions
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 你的书在桌子上，我的手机在这里。
1.en: Your book is on the table, and my phone is here.

2.zh: 学校在左边，医院在右边，超市在前面。
2.en: The school is on the left, the hospital is on the right, and the supermarket is ahead.

3.zh: 我家在公园和学校中间，附近到处都是树。
3.en: My home is between the park and the school, and there are trees everywhere nearby.

3.zh: 中国的北方很冷，南方很热。
3.en: The north of China is cold and the south is hot.

1.zh: 我今天去学校，明天回家。
1.en: I go to school today and go home tomorrow.

2.zh: 你进来吧，我出去一下就回来。
2.en: Come in; I will go out for a moment and be right back.

3.zh: 我们八点出发，经过公园，离开这个城市。
3.en: We set off at eight, go past the park and leave this city.

topics.name: Roads and distance
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
1.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

2.zh: 学校离我家很近，走路十分钟就到了。
2.en: The school is very near my home; it takes ten minutes on foot.

3.zh: 过马路的时候，请看红绿灯。
3.en: When you cross the road, please look at the traffic light.

topics.name: Transport and tickets
topics.cta: Use these to ask where something is

1.zh: 我坐出租车去，你坐火车去。
1.en: I go by taxi, and you go by train.

2.zh: 我坐地铁去机场，你坐公交车去车站。
2.en: I take the subway to the airport, and you take the bus to the station.

3.zh: 我骑自行车去，你坐高铁去。
3.en: I will go by bicycle, and you go by high-speed train.

1.zh: 我想去中国玩，你呢？
1.en: I want to go and have fun in China; what about you?

2.zh: 我想出国旅游，已经买了机票。
2.en: I want to travel abroad, and I have already bought the plane ticket.

3.zh: 出国要带护照，也要带好行李。
3.en: To go abroad you need to bring your passport and pack your luggage well.

1.zh: 我家有三个房间，桌子和椅子在大房间里。
1.en: My home has three rooms; the table and chairs are in the big room.

2.zh: 我家在三楼，洗手间在门口旁边。
2.en: My home is on the third floor, and the restroom is next to the doorway.

3.zh: 我们搬家了，新房子在十二层，有电梯。
3.en: We have moved house; the new home is on the 12th floor and has an elevator.

3.zh: 家里有沙发、冰箱、洗衣机和空调。
3.en: At home there is a sofa, a fridge, a washing machine and an air conditioner.

1.zh: 桌子和椅子在家里。
1.en: The table and chairs are at home.

2.zh: 我的床在桌子旁边。
2.en: My bed is next to the table.

1.zh: 我是大学生，我哥哥是中学生。
1.en: I am a university student, and my older brother is a middle-school student.

2.zh: 明天开学，我要去教室找老师。
2.en: School starts tomorrow; I will go to the classroom to find my teacher.

3.zh: 新学期开始了，校长来我们班看我们。
3.en: The new term has started, and the principal came to our class to see us.

3.zh: 我喜欢历史和音乐，不太喜欢数学。
3.en: I like history and music, but I do not like maths very much.

1.zh: 我学习汉语，我有很多问题。
1.en: I study Chinese, and I have many questions.

2.zh: 明天考试，这些题我都懂，没有问题。
2.en: The exam is tomorrow; I understand all these questions, so there is no problem.

3.zh: 考试以前要好好复习，才能提高成绩。
3.en: Before the exam you should review well, so that you can improve your grades.

1.zh: 我学汉语，会写一些汉字。
1.en: I study Chinese and can write some characters.

2.zh: 我每天读书、写汉字，也学新词。
2.en: Every day I read, write characters and learn new words.

3.zh: 请用这个词写一个句子，再去查词典。
3.en: Please write a sentence with this word, and then go and look it up in the dictionary.

1.zh: 我的手机在桌子上，请打电话给我。
1.en: My phone is on the table; please call me.

2.zh: 我每天上网看电影，网上的东西很多。
2.en: I go online to watch movies every day; there is a lot online.

3.zh: 我的手机关机了，你可以发邮件给我。
3.en: My phone is switched off, so you can send me an email.

1.zh: 我早上起床，晚上睡觉，中午吃饭。
1.en: I get up in the morning, go to bed in the evening and eat at noon.

2.zh: 我早上起床，洗手，穿衣服，吃早饭。
2.en: In the morning I get up, wash my hands, get dressed and eat breakfast.

3.zh: 我每天晚上洗澡，早上刷牙。
3.en: I take a shower every evening and brush my teeth in the morning.

1.zh: 今天天气很冷，在下雨，明天会下雪。
1.en: The weather is cold today and it is raining; it will snow tomorrow.

2.zh: 昨天是阴天，今天是晴天。
2.en: Yesterday was cloudy, and today is sunny.

3.zh: 今天刮风，天气很凉快，你不用带伞。
3.en: It is windy today and the weather is nicely cool, so you do not need to bring an umbrella.

3.zh: 山上有很多树，河边的草地很大。
3.en: There are many trees on the mountain, and the grassland by the river is very big.

2.zh: 这些花很漂亮。
2.en: These flowers are very pretty.

1.zh: 我家有一只狗和一只猫。
1.en: My family has a dog and a cat.

2.zh: 那只鸟很漂亮，我很喜欢这些花。
2.en: That bird is very pretty, and I like these flowers a lot.

3.zh: 我们明天去动物园看大熊猫。
3.en: Tomorrow we are going to the zoo to see the giant pandas.

1.zh: 我喜欢白色和绿色，不喜欢黑色。
1.en: I like white and green, and I do not like black.

2.zh: 我喜欢白色和绿色，不喜欢黑色。
2.en: I like white and green, and I do not like black.

3.zh: 天很蓝，花是黄色的。
3.en: The sky is very blue and the flowers are yellow.

1.zh: 你喜欢玩什么？
1.en: What do you like to play?

2.zh: 我的爱好是画画和跳舞，很有意思。
2.en: My hobbies are drawing and dancing, and they are very interesting.

3.zh: 我对爬山很感兴趣，常常拿相机拍照。
3.en: I am very interested in climbing mountains and often take photos with my camera.

3.zh: 明天晚上有生日晚会，欢迎你来！
3.en: There is a birthday party tomorrow evening, and you are welcome to come!

1.zh: 我喜欢看电影，也喜欢听歌。
1.en: I like watching movies, and I also like listening to songs.

2.zh: 我喜欢看电影，也喜欢听歌。
2.en: I like watching movies, and I also like listening to songs.

3.zh: 我常常看新闻，也喜欢听音乐。
3.en: I often watch the news, and I also like listening to music.

1.zh: 我喜欢运动，也喜欢踢足球和打篮球。
1.en: I like sports, and I also like playing soccer and basketball.

2.zh: 我喜欢运动，也喜欢踢足球和打篮球。
2.en: I like sports, and I also like playing soccer and basketball.

3.zh: 他每天锻炼，打网球和羽毛球。
3.en: He exercises every day and plays tennis and badminton.

1.zh: 他生病了，我们去医院看医生。
1.en: He is ill, so we go to the hospital to see a doctor.

2.zh: 我头疼，身体不舒服，要吃药。
2.en: I have a headache and do not feel well; I need to take medicine.

3.zh: 他个子很高，头发很短，眼睛很大。
3.en: He is tall, his hair is very short and his eyes are big.

1.zh: 他生病了，我们去医院看医生。
1.en: He is ill, so we go to the hospital to see a doctor.

2.zh: 我头疼，身体不舒服，要吃药。
2.en: I have a headache and do not feel well; I need to take medicine.

3.zh: 他发烧了，要住院检查一下。
3.en: He has a fever and needs to be admitted to hospital for an examination.

1.zh: 我很高兴，你也很高兴吗？
1.en: I am very happy; are you happy too?

2.zh: 今天我很快乐，也有一点儿累。
2.en: I am very happy today, and a little tired too.

3.zh: 考试以前我很着急，也有点儿害怕。
3.en: Before the exam I was anxious and a little afraid.

3.zh: 他很聪明，也很努力，学习很认真。
3.en: He is very clever and hard-working, and he studies seriously.

1.zh: 我知道，我觉得这个很好，我想买。
1.en: I know; I think this one is good, and I want to buy it.

2.zh: 我希望你记得，不要忘了，我懂你的意思。
2.en: I hope you remember; do not forget; I understand what you mean.

3.zh: 我以为你知道，其实你不了解这里。
3.en: I thought you knew, but in fact you do not know this place well.

1.zh: 我在做饭，你可以开电视吗？
1.en: I am cooking; can you turn on the TV?

2.zh: 请帮我拿一下书，我来洗杯子。
2.en: Please help me take the book; I will wash the cups.

3.zh: 请把书放在桌子上，再把门关上。
3.en: Please put the book on the table and then close the door.

3.zh: 这件太小了，我想换一件衣服，再试一试。
3.en: This one is too small, so I want to change it for another garment and try it on.

1.zh: 我看见他了，他说话，我听见了。
1.en: I saw him; he spoke, and I heard it.

2.zh: 请告诉我，你问他了吗？
2.en: Please tell me: did you ask him?

3.zh: 我听说你会讲汉语，我们聊聊天儿吧。
3.en: I heard that you can speak Chinese. Let us have a chat.

3.zh: 我们明天见面，欢迎你来我家做客。
3.en: We are meeting tomorrow, and you are welcome to visit my home.

1.zh: 请坐。
1.en: Please sit down.

2.zh: 他在那儿跑步，我站在这里看。
2.en: He is running over there, and I am standing here watching.

3.zh: 他会爬山，会骑马，也会跳舞。
3.en: He can climb mountains, ride horses and dance.

1.zh: 请等一下，我做完就开始。
1.en: Please wait a moment; I will start as soon as I finish.

2.zh: 请等一下，我做完就开始。
2.en: Please wait a moment; I will start as soon as I finish.

3.zh: 只要坚持，你就一定能完成。
3.en: As long as you keep at it, you will surely be able to finish.

1.zh: 这个大，那个小，这里的人很多。
1.en: This one is big, that one is small, and there are many people here.

2.zh: 他跑得快，我走得慢，路很长。
2.en: He runs fast, I walk slowly, and the road is long.

3.zh: 她个子很矮，这条裤子太长了，大小不合适。
3.en: She is very short; these trousers are too long and the size does not fit.

1.zh: 这个菜很好吃，这本书很新。
1.en: This dish is very tasty, and this book is new.

2.zh: 这个不错，那个坏了。
2.en: This one is not bad; that one is broken.

3.zh: 这个办法不行，我觉得不合适。
3.en: This way will not work, and I do not think it is suitable.

3.zh: 这个小区很干净，也很安静，很安全。
3.en: This neighbourhood is very clean, quiet and safe.

3.zh: 这个问题很简单，但是那个难题不容易。
3.en: This question is simple, but that hard problem is not easy.

3.zh: 我们的手机一样，但是颜色不同。
3.en: Our phones are the same, but the colours are different.

1.zh: 这些东西是我的，这件事我知道。
1.en: These things are mine, and I know about this matter.

2.zh: 这件事情我已经知道了，不是问题。
2.en: I already know about this matter, and it is not a problem.

3.zh: 这个机会对你的生活很重要。
3.en: This chance is very important for your life.

1.zh: 我是学生，我有一个哥哥，他在家。
1.en: I am a student, I have an older brother, and he is at home.

2.zh: 我是学生，我有一个哥哥，他在家。
2.en: I am a student, I have an older brother, and he is at home.

1.zh: 我想去中国，我会说一点儿汉语，我能去吗？
1.en: I want to go to China; I can speak a little Chinese; may I go?

2.zh: 他今天可能不来，老师让他在家休息。
2.en: He may not come today; the teacher told him to rest at home.

3.zh: 你应该早一点儿睡，不用等我。
3.en: You should go to bed a bit earlier; you do not need to wait for me.

1.zh: 我不想去，我没有时间，你不要问了。
1.en: I do not want to go, and I have no time; you should not ask again.

2.zh: 别等我，我不去了。
2.en: Do not wait for me; I am not going.

topics.name: If, only if, in order to

3.en: If it does not rain tomorrow, we will go to the park.

3.en: It looks like it will probably rain tomorrow, so you must bring an umbrella.

3.en: Thank you for your help; I have already received the email you sent.
